title: Nigeria Marine Biodiversity Reference Library (NMBRL), release v22.5

creators.name: Odedere, Adelodun O.
creators.affiliation: Nigerian Institute for Oceanography and Marine Research (NIOMR)

description: Versioned gap analysis of DNA reference-sequence coverage (NCBI Nucleotide, BOLD Systems v5, SILVA) for 136 coastal and marine taxa of Nigeria and the Gulf of Guinea. Database queries 14-16 November 2026. Data and documentation CC BY 4.0; scripts MIT.
